title: NightWatch Finding
description: Cross-run problem entity after reproduction and review (§5.8, §15). Fingerprint composition source: §15 (api_id + normalized_method_path + assertion_class + normalized_status_or_error + response_signature + scenario_state). Internal root-cause statements may ONLY live in the 'hypothesis' field, which defaults to empty (§14.1).

fingerprint.description: Dedup fingerprint, all six components mandatory (§15).

classification.description: confirmed / flaky / environmental / spec-ambiguity / inconclusive / duplicate (§5.8).

reproduction.description: Reproduction history: attempts, failures, rate (aggregated across runs by fingerprint).

hypothesis.description: MAY contain suspected internal causes, explicitly marked as hypothesis and separated from confirmed external symptoms. Defaults to empty.

issue_refs.description: External issue references linked to this finding (existing issues get new reproduction info appended, §15).
